propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: both 'author forgot' and 'no file impact' map to the same value, forcing conservative interpretation by all consumers.
The FILE_IMPACT event payload must gain file_impact_scope (enum: undeclared|paths|none) and no_file_impact_reason (string) keys to disambiguate the three states.

The reducer state must track file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason, with derivation logic ensuring non-empty file_impact → 'paths', empty file_impact + payload scope 'none' → 'none', otherwise → 'undeclared'.

The CLI set-file-impact command must migrate from _REGISTRY to _ARGV_REGISTRY and support both rebar set-file-impact <id> '<json>' and rebar set-file-impact <id> --none '<reason>' forms, with reason validation enforcing at least 10 non-whitespace characters.
A new library function get_file_impact_scope(ticket_id) and MCP tool declare_no_file_impact(ticket_id, reason) must expose the tri-state and enforce the same reason validation as the CLI.
The plain JSON-array form of set-file-impact must retain backward compatibility in output, exit codes, and behavior after the _ARGV_REGISTRY migration.
